app_fee.value: No application fee is charged for PhD candidate admission at UvA.
app_fee.quote: Before you can start a PhD at the UvA, you must meet a number of admission requirements.

fee_waiver.value: No PhD application fee is charged.
fee_waiver.quote: Before you can start a PhD at the UvA, you must meet a number of admission requirements.

gre_general.value: GRE General is not required for doctoral admission at UvA.
gre_general.quote: Before you can start a PhD at the UvA, you must meet a number of admission requirements.

toefl_min.value: No central TOEFL score is required; a faculty or institute may set additional requirements regarding language proficiency.
toefl_min.quote: A faculty or institute may set additional requirements regarding your language proficiency.

ielts_min.value: No central IELTS score is required; a faculty or institute may set additional requirements regarding language proficiency.
ielts_min.quote: A faculty or institute may set additional requirements regarding your language proficiency.

english_waiver.value: UvA sets no central PhD rule on English-medium degrees from India; individual faculties or research institutes set any additional language requirements.

notes: Checked UvA PhD portal (https://www.uva.nl/en/research/phd/phd.html), admission to a doctoral programme, how to find a PhD position, PhD vacancy portal (https://werkenbij.uva.nl/en/phd), and UvA Doctorate Regulations PDF (July 2024). Central PhD admission requires 'a good command of English' and lets faculties/institutes set additional language requirements; no central PhD application fee, GRE rule, or test minimum is stated (some institutes charge annual bench/programme fees for non-employed external PhDs). Old regulations page documents-forms-and-regulations.html returned 404 (PDF linked directly from admission page).
